title: Naa Saami Ranga
desc: A man gains great notoriety in his village for his unmatched strength and brutal nature, which makes him a target of antisocial elements with a ruthless agenda.

title: Bheemla Nayak
desc: A battle begins between SI Bheemla Nayak, a righteous policeman, and Daniel Shekhar, an ex-havildar, when Daniel tricks Bheemla into surrendering to corruption.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Mr. Bachchan
desc: Suspended for his honesty, an income tax officer returns to his hometown to live with his family. However, he is soon reinstated and tasked with raiding the home of a corrupt politician.

title: War 2
desc: Things get complicated when Kabir Dhaliwal, a secret agent, is accused of betraying his nation and his former batchmate shoulders the responsibility of finding him.

title: Tholi Prema
desc: Fate offers Aditya and Varsha the opportunity to rekindle their youthful romance years after personality differences compelled them to go their separate ways.

title: Vyjayanthi
desc: Vyjayanthi, a brave army officer, is tasked with wiping out terrorist activities in Visunoor. Here, she crosses paths with Vadivakkarasi, a tyrannical ruler who has links to her troubled past.

title: Gurudev Hoysala
desc: Gurudev Hoysala, a morally upright police inspector, is transferred to Athani to investigate a fellow officer's disappearance. However, a suspicious young couple soon complicates the case.

title: Shock
desc: Sekhar and Madhurima's happily married life is ruined when he's falsely accused of being Maoist by corrupt officials. However, Geeta, a journalist, tries to prove his innocence but to no avail.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: Ambajipeta Marriage Band
desc: The twins Malli and Padma in the Andhra Pradesh hamlet of Ambajipeta grow up to be accomplished workers as they negotiate relationships and society's expectations.

title: Amaran
desc: Major Mukund Varadarajan, a commissioned officer in the Rajput Regiment of the Indian Army, conducts a counterterrorism operation while being deployed to Jammu and Kashmir.

title: Sarvam Maya
desc: After crossing paths with a ghost, a Hindu priest embarks on an enlightening journey that causes him to question his faith, his identity and everything he believed to be true.
